name: tabloid
archetype: Ad-heavy celebrity gossip and tabloid news site
market: United States, mass-market entertainment news, 18-45 demographic
density: Overwhelming. Every section sandwiched between ads. Auto-playing video ads in sticky sidebar. Three ads above the fold before any article content. Photo slideshows dominate. Related articles panels interrupt article text every three paragraphs. Outbrain/Taboola-style recommended content fills the bottom third of every page.
nav_style: Sticky top nav with the brand logo in hot pink. 8 category tabs: Celebrity, TV, Music, Movies, Style, Beauty, Royals, Viral. Below nav: a horizontal trending ticker showing today's top 10 stories with red 'HOT' badges. Hamburger menu on mobile.
commercial_model: Aggressively ad-supported. Display ads in every possible placement: leaderboard, billboard, half-page, interstitial, sticky sidebar, native content (labeled 'Sponsored'). Email newsletter popup after 5 seconds. Push notification request prompt. Subscription offer popup on exit intent.
color_palette: Hot pink (#FF1493) as brand primary. Black (#000000) for text and nav. White (#FFFFFF) page backgrounds. Gold (#FFD700) for star ratings and VIP badges. Red (#FF0000) for 'BREAKING' and trending badges. The overall effect is loud, maximalist, and deliberately attention-grabbing.
typography: Montserrat for headlines — very bold, very large (36-48px for feature headlines). Georgia for article body at 16px with generous line-height. Pull quotes in oversized italic. Photo captions in small grey sans-serif. Celebrity name callouts in hot pink bold.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Hero feature story with full-bleed celebrity photo. Below it a masonry grid of gossip stories with thumbnail images. Trending sidebar. Three ad placements above the fold. Viral video section.

pages.title: Celebrity News
pages.description: Rolling celebrity news feed with paparazzi photos. Who's dating who, who wore what, breakup/makeup stories. Photo-heavy card grid with sensational headlines.

pages.title: TV & Streaming
pages.description: Reality TV recaps, streaming service drama, cast drama, ratings news. Episode recap articles with screenshot galleries. Viewer polls.

pages.title: Style & Fashion
pages.description: Red carpet photos, best/worst dressed rankings, outfit breakdowns with shopping links. Photo slideshow format with swipe interface.

pages.title: Viral & WTF
pages.description: Viral social media moments, weird news, internet drama. Video embeds, tweet screenshots, Reddit roundups. Outrage bait adjacent but fun.
